purpose: Teach: ゴージャス/重荷/土星/母乳/モザイク/軍艦/パジャマ/タマネギ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、ゴージャスなクリスマス飾るな
lines.en: Your family really goes all out with the Christmas decorations, doesn't it?
lines.style: Teasing opening with a slight smirk in the voice. Casual, familiar accusation. Quick rhythm. Not mean—just poking because she can.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、塾の宿題、重荷に感じてんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're actually stressed about all that cram school homework, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle redirect, half-serious. Observant but not confrontational. Steady pace. A small smile underneath—he sees through her deflection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、理科で土星の単元やったろ?
lines.en: You covered Saturn in science class, right?
lines.style: Pouncing back with her own observation. Bright, quick rhythm. Testing whether he'll notice the pattern she's setting up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科で母乳の授業やったろ?桜
lines.en: You had that whole lesson on breastfeeding in home ec, didn't you?
lines.style: Matching her rhythm, turning the tables with equal precision. Calm delivery masking amusement. He's not embarrassed—he's matching her move for move.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゲームのモザイク表現嫌いだろ?
lines.en: You hate how games use that blur effect on certain things, don't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation, escalating slightly. Faster tempo. She's narrowing in, testing his patience—or his honesty.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で軍艦島やったろ?桜
lines.en: You did the whole unit on Gunkanjima in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, knowing rhythm. Not missing a beat. He's following her game perfectly, each example building on the last.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お洒落なパジャマ買ったろ?
lines.en: You actually bought yourself those fancy pajamas, right?
lines.style: Teasing spike with a hint of genuine curiosity. Quick, almost gotcha-like. She's pushing to see if he'll finally react.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科でタマネギ切れたろ?桜
lines.en: You managed to actually cut an onion properly in home ec, didn't you?
lines.style: Final point, delivered with easy confidence. Calm, close to her ear almost. A shared laugh underneath—he's landed his move.
